title: Analog Attachable Manifest
description: Meta-schema that analog-attach validates every tool manifest against at init time and on content-hash change.

protocol_version.description: Semver string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Major must match analog-attach's own major; mismatch is a hard error.

commands.description: Map from command name to its invocation mapping. Required commands must all be present.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this command does in the context of this specific tool. Used by agents to explain commands to users when driving analog-attach interactions.

argv.description: The argv prefix prepended by analog-attach when dispatching this command. First element is typically the binary name or path.

args.description: Tool-defined JSON Schema fragment for extra optional args. May only add optional properties — a top-level 'required' keyword is forbidden. Merged with the protocol base schema via allOf before input validation.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds analog-attach waits for this command's process. Process is killed and a transport error is raised on expiry. Absent means no timeout.

completions.description: Completion hints for shell tab-completion and agent argument completion.

arg.description: Either a flag name (without '--') whose value should be completed, or the command name itself for positional argument completion. Must not equal the command's own name when used as a flag name.

kind.description: Completion kind token. Must be advertised by list-intelligence for candidates to be returned; an unadvertised kind silently yields no candidates.
